packageRules.description: uv (Astral) is COPYed into both session-worker images from ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv. It used to be an unpinned `:latest`, which — because deploy.sh builds with --pull — re-resolved on every uv release and invalidated every layer below it (agent CLIs, Playwright+Chrome, JDK, Android SDK, Gradle). It is pinned now, so Renovate owns the bump under the same 7-day supply-chain cooldown as the agent CLIs. Both Dockerfiles must move together, so group them into one PR; a human reviews and merges.

The node base image in the session-worker Dockerfiles is deliberately NOT Renovate-managed. Its digest is duplicated by hand into the BASE_IMAGE_DIGEST build arg in the same files, which src/server/session/install-runtime.ts uses as part of the dependency-install cache key. Renovate would bump the FROM lines and leave that ARG default stale, silently keying installs to a base image that is no longer in use. Bump the FROM lines and the ARG together, by hand.

Agent CLIs baked into ShipIt session-worker/orchestrator images (docs/141-cli-version-strategy). Hold every new version for the 7-day supply-chain cooldown, group all three into a single PR, and keep the bump as exact pins so docker/agent-cli/package-lock.json is regenerated with fresh integrity hashes. Auto-merge stays OFF until the Axis-3 CLI contract test is wired as a required status check — until then a human reviews + merges the bump PR.
